description: Narammala Pradeshiya Sabha - Roads and Thoroughfares of the Narammala Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notification primarily deals with land and property matters, specifically the declaration of roads and thoroughfares as property owned by the Pradeshiya Sabha Narammala local government authority. It includes detailed schedules of land coordinates, dimensions, and legal procedures for land claims, which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land acquisition matters.
